reason: Owner scope computation: properties inside the owner's portfolios, consumed as an id list for ReBAC scoping; bounded by the owner's holdings. Follow-up: push scoping into SQL (docs/qa/hardening-qa.md).

Monthly invoice generation iterates every active lease of the org once per period (idempotent per lease/period, triggered by a manager action or the scheduler). Follow-up: chunk by cursor when an org exceeds a few thousand active leases.
Aging summary aggregates outstanding invoices with a 3-column select; to be replaced by SQL aggregation (groupBy) when volume warrants.
Finance summary KPI aggregates outstanding invoices with a 4-column select; same follow-up as the aging summary.
ReBAC edges of the current actor: `base` carries subjectType=user and subjectId=ctx.actor.userId, so the set is the actor's own relationships.
Legal-hold flagging walks every document in the hold scope (select id only) so each is marked held; governance batch, not a user-facing list.
Packet export collects all leases of the exported property inside a worker job; output is written to storage, not returned as a page.
Scheduled retention sweep iterates all orgs (select id) once a day; org count is small by construction.
